title: The Abyss Ocean
description: Reshape the entire world generation with this mod, the entire world turns into a deep-abyss ocean. Structures like Villages, Trial Chambers, and Strongholds rarely spawn.
body:
# The Abyss Ocean

This mod changes your typical world generation to a new experience, rather than having a normal and plain world with your usual terrain, your world becomes an infinite deep ocean, explore new islands, and try to live your life out in the ocean.

All the features:

- Changed world generation from your typical world, to a vast deep ocean with islands,
- Trial Chambers, Villages, and Strongholds spawn less and are rarer,
- Changed the size of Villages to very small,
- Custom generated islands - Each time a new seed is chosen, a new infinite variant, placement & size of islands is generated,
- Nether & End are preserved as in plain Vanilla.

## Inspiration:

- The mod is inspired by the series of Unstable SMP, exactly the Great Sea terrain in the series - a deep long ocean. The series can be found on YouTube by searching ,,Unstable SMP'' 

## Bug Reporting:

Bugs can be reported to me on discord: houstonp901 - I accept friend requests & read private messages. 

### Additional:

- Use shaders for the best experience.
- For suggestions, please message me on Discord: houstonp901 - I accept friend requests & read private messages.
